---
title: "Accuracy Metric Calculation"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-27"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Data Directories, Validation, Models, and Traits
model_list <- c("GBLUP","XGB_BLUP","XGB_Env")
trait_list <- c("YLD_BE","TWT","PHT")
blup <- c("_BLUP","_BLUP","")
validation_list <- c(2000,2001,2002,2003,2004,2005,2006,2007,2008)

combdf <- NULL

# calculate metrics for each fold

for(t in 1:3){
  for(m in 1:3){
    for(v in 1:9){
      
      model <- model_list[m]
      trait_file <- paste0(trait_list[t],blup[m])
      trait <- trait_list[t]
      fold <- validation_list[v]
      
      df <- read.csv(paste0(model,"_Pred/",fold,"_",trait_file,".csv"))
      colnames(df) <- c("LINE_UNIQUE_ID","Actual","Prediction")
      
      count <- nrow(df)
      
      # RMSE
      df <- df %>% summarize(
      
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((Actual - Prediction)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # R2 (Pearson Correlation Squared)
    R2 = cor(Actual, Prediction, use = "complete.obs")^2,
    
    # Top 10% Rank Accuracy: % of true top 10% predicted in top 10%
    Top_10_Accuracy = sum(Actual >= quantile(Actual, 0.90) & 
                          Prediction >= quantile(Prediction, 0.90)) / 
                      sum(Actual >= quantile(Actual, 0.90)),
    
    # Top 25% Rank Accuracy: % of true top 25% predicted in top 25%
    Top_25_Accuracy = sum(Actual >= quantile(Actual, 0.75) & 
                          Prediction >= quantile(Prediction, 0.75)) / 
                      sum(Actual >= quantile(Actual, 0.75)),
    
    # Bottom 25% in Top 25%: % of true bottom 25% mistakenly predicted as top 25%
    Bot_25_in_Top_25 = sum(Actual <= quantile(Actual, 0.25) & 
                           Prediction >= quantile(Prediction, 0.75)) / 
                       sum(Actual <= quantile(Actual, 0.25)))
    
    stat_vec <- df %>% mutate(Model = model, Fold = fold, Trait = trait,N = count)
    
    combdf <- rbind(combdf,stat_vec)
      
      
    }
  }
}

# QUuantify Uncertainty across folds

summary_df <- combdf %>%
  group_by(Model, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    
    RMSE_mean = mean(RMSE),
    RMSE_sd = sd(RMSE),
    
    R2_mean = mean(R2),
    R2_sd = sd(R2),
    
    Top_10_mean = mean(Top_10_Accuracy),
    Top_10_sd = sd(Top_10_Accuracy),
    
    Top_25_mean = mean(Top_25_Accuracy),
    Top_25_sd = sd(Top_25_Accuracy),
    
    Bot_25_Top_25_mean = mean(Bot_25_in_Top_25),
    Bot_25_Top_25_sd = sd(Bot_25_in_Top_25),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Desired order
trait_order <- c("YLD_BE", "TWT", "PHT")
model_order <- c("GBLUP", "XGB_BLUP", "XGB_Env")

# Format mean ± SD
display_long <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", RMSE_mean, RMSE_sd),
    R2 = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", R2_mean, R2_sd),
    Top_10 = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Top_10_mean, Top_10_sd),
    Top_25 = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Top_25_mean, Top_25_sd),
    Bot_25_Top_25 = sprintf(
      "%.3f ± %.3f",
      Bot_25_Top_25_mean,
      Bot_25_Top_25_sd
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Trait, Model,
    RMSE, R2, Top_10, Top_25, Bot_25_Top_25
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(RMSE, R2, Top_10, Top_25, Bot_25_Top_25),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Force desired Trait × Model order
display_long <- display_long %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = factor(Trait, levels = trait_order),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = model_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Trait, Model)

# Make wide table
display_df <- display_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(Trait, Model),
    values_from = Value
  )


display_df %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Metric") %>%
  cols_label(
    Metric = "Accuracy Metric",

    YLD_BE_GBLUP = "GBLUP",
    YLD_BE_XGB_BLUP = "XGB_BLUP",
    YLD_BE_XGB_Env = "XGB_Env",

    TWT_GBLUP = "GBLUP",
    TWT_XGB_BLUP = "XGB_BLUP",
    TWT_XGB_Env = "XGB_Env",

    PHT_GBLUP = "GBLUP",
    PHT_XGB_BLUP = "XGB_BLUP",
    PHT_XGB_Env = "XGB_Env"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "YLD_BE",
    columns = c(
      YLD_BE_GBLUP,
      YLD_BE_XGB_BLUP,
      YLD_BE_XGB_Env
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "TWT",
    columns = c(
      TWT_GBLUP,
      TWT_XGB_BLUP,
      TWT_XGB_Env
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "PHT",
    columns = c(
      PHT_GBLUP,
      PHT_XGB_BLUP,
      PHT_XGB_Env
    )
  )
```
